records.title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
records.reason: RAGEN-2 proposes reward-variance prompt filtering to improve agent RL training and reasoning quality; it does not reduce deployed inference compute, memory, tokens, or latency.

records.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation
records.reason: The paper formulates sequential recommendation as autoregressive generation over semantic IDs and targets recommendation quality; the abstract gives no inference-efficiency method or serving measurement.

records.title: Stable-RAG: Mitigating Retrieval-Permutation-Induced Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
records.reason: The method executes all 5! retrieved-document permutations to collect final-layer states and clusters them, then decodes representatives. Its contribution is RAG answer stability/accuracy via permutation analysis and DPO, not reducing normal LLM serving cost; the 120-permutation pass is itself substantial inference work.

records.title: On the Planning Abilities of Large Language Models (A Critical Investigation with a Proposed Benchmark)
records.reason: This is a planning-capability benchmark and critical investigation, not an inference optimization method.

records.title: ClawGUI: A Unified Framework for Training, Evaluating, and Deploying GUI Agents
records.reason: ClawGUI is a training/evaluation/deployment framework for GUI agents; its abstract describes interface interaction and framework construction, with no concrete inference-compute or serving reduction.
